_rule: Only change passes/evidence after a customer walk on a real box. Never edit or remove a journey's steps; scope changes need kien and SHIP.md.

journeys.title: Clean install from a signed release, sign in, turn on two-step
steps: install.sh from a signed release on a clean box
first-run setup and admin sign-in
turn on two-step and sign in again

journeys.title: Scan the LAN, see devices with vendor and version
steps: plug the box into the LAN
within 1 hour Devices lists the LAN
firewall, router, printer, servers show vendor and, where exposed, version

journeys.title: A new KEV matching a device raises a finding and an alert within 1 hour
steps: a KEV entry matches a device
a finding appears
the alert reaches Email or Telegram within 1 hour

journeys.title: Open a finding: patch guidance and firewall mitigation config
steps: open the finding
see the fixed version and link
see a ready mitigation config for the firewall in use (a confirmed pack's guide, or Ask my AI; the generated General hardening configs are gone, D-629)
see how to check whether it was already exploited
journeys.evidence: PASS on n76, 2026-11-17 (AI-Mlee as qa-walker, browser). Juniper EX4200 CVE-2023-36845: advisory link and 'NVD names no fixed release for 15.1R7.9'; WINLAB01 CVE-2025-59287 'Fixed in 10.0.26100.6905'. General hardening (#900): FortiGate in Devices preselected, FortiGate/MikroTik/nftables configs for 192.168.18.47 ports 22/80/443 after typing the admin network, Vedette box allowed, lock-out warning. Have I been hit?: Junos commands (show system commit, UI_LOGIN_EVENT log search, users, /var/tmp, listeners). Ask my AI: Junos block disabling J-Web + FortiGate policy, not cut. Not pasted on a real FortiGate. sessions/customer-walk-n76.md.

journeys.title: Plan page says what to update
steps: open Updates to plan
each item names the update, the device and the CVEs it fixes
likely-exploited first

journeys.title: Public IP: exposed ports and service versions
steps: the box finds its public IP
Exposure shows open ports
each port shows the service and version

Box found 222.254.212.114 itself; deep scan 23:02-00:49 UTC lists 6 open ports, each with what the service gives: 10022 OpenSSH 9.6p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu13.20; 10443 HTTPS nginx (no version sent) + certificate git.beyondnetglobal.com, title GitLab; 11443 TLS, certificate FortiGate; 5060 and 2000 'Probably SIP / Cisco SCCP, by port number, not confirmed'; 11080 'Service not identified' (nmap -sV --version-all, #899). sessions/customer-walk-n76.md W76-4..7.

take a backup
restore it on a clean box
